svg.title: LNClassifier supplementary workflow DAGs
svg.desc: Independent benchmark and feature-generation workflows followed by explicit input-to-analysis-to-output rows. Uncertainty uses benchmark tables; statistical testing requires uncertainty and clusters; embeddings and RF/SHAP are separate computations.
svg.text: Benchmark and feature generation run independently; their outputs converge for downstream analysis and publication.
Shared annotation and assembly for B–D: GENCODE v47 · GRCh38

g.text: Classifier benchmark, run independently of feature generation.
D · RNA structure and rG4 analysis
Separate outputs: rG4detector features + ScanFold2 features
E · Feature integration and downstream analysis
Supplementary features are used in downstream analysis and RF/SHAP, independently of benchmark classifier training.
Read each row left to right. Repeated input names refer to the same data; each input list contains separate artifacts.
